method_note: Each invariant was confirmed against the CURRENT deployed code (the source of truth for a regression). Behavioral invariants were additionally confirmed live this session where marked (network tab / DOM inspection on the running dev server on :5181) or via prior live runs within this same eval cycle (Trials 1-3.5). No invariant was marked pass without either a live observation or a direct code confirmation of the exact call site.
infrastructure_note: temperature: 0 on Groq/Llama produced a P2 flip between Trial 3 and Trial 3.5 (false positive count: 1/5 → 2/5 on the same input). This is inconsistent with deterministic temperature-0 behavior as implemented by the Anthropic API. Either Groq's temperature-0 implementation is non-deterministic, or an unidentified environmental variable changed between runs. This is not treated as expected noise — it is a known infrastructure characteristic that may affect reliability of eval comparisons across runs on this provider.

trace_invariants.I1_observation: Threshold is 2 nodes. At 0 nodes MapView early-returns the empty state with no scan button (MapView:1713); otherwise the buttons are gated on getScopedNodes(activeNodes, false).length >= 2 (MapView:1763), so at 1 node the button is still absent. Prior-cycle live confirmed the button appears only with 2+ nodes.
trace_invariants.I2_observation: Live: on Map view load with many nodes, only 'Scan for Patterns' was present in the DOM; 'Deep Scan' absent. deepAvailable = useState(false) (MapView:1570) and Deep Scan renders only when deepAvailable (1794), which flips true only after a standard scan returns results (1669).
trace_invariants.I3_observation: Live: a single 'Scan for Patterns' click produced exactly one POST /api/chat (200). Both scan and Deep Scan route through the same runScan → runTraceScan single-fetch path (MapView:1652, 1774, 1796), so each click = one request, no double-fire, correct endpoint.
trace_invariants.I4_observation: Ghost Edges live in ephemeral React state (ghostEdges = useState, MapView:1568) and are NEVER written to the persisted edge list on creation — a stronger guarantee than storing them as ai_proposed_pending. On Accept, handleAcceptGhost calls store.addEdge with provenance 'ai_proposed_confirmed' (MapView:1691-1696) and removes the ghost. Verified live in Trial 1: edge count 5→6 on Accept, new edge provenance ai_proposed_confirmed; no pending edge ever appeared in the persisted edge list.
trace_invariants.I5_observation: handleDismissGhost calls addDismissedPair (MapView:1706), which stores both orderings in the persisted dismissedPairs array (store.ts); buildEligiblePairs excludes dismissed pairs on the next scan (trace.ts). Verified live in Trial 1: dismissedPairs became ["c1|p2","p2|c1"] and eligible pairs dropped 16→14, and the dismissed pair did not reappear.
trace_invariants.I6_observation: Live: hard-load network trace shows zero POST /api/chat before any click. runTraceScan is reachable only via runScan, called only from the two button onClick handlers — no mount effect, timer, or subscription fires it. Flow's Replay is a separate user-initiated path on /api/replay, not /api/chat, so it cannot be miscounted as a Trace call.

embedding_prefilter: Not implemented. False positive rates across Trials 3 and 3.5 (1/5 and 2/5) on 3-14 node test sets are below the threshold defined as triggering this feature (worse than 1 false positive per 2 correct at scale of 20-30+ nodes). All testing has occurred at well below production scale. Decision: revisit if false positive rate increases when tested on real projects with 20+ nodes. No action required at current scale.

summary.verdict: PASS — eval cycle complete. No invariant regressed. The Trial 3 structured-output + ID-validation changes, the Trial 3.5 adversarial run, and the Trial 4 CoT prompt swap all touched only prompt strings and validation logic; none altered the trigger gating, spawn/provenance, tether, result-card labeling, ghost-edge ephemerality, dismissed-pair persistence, or the zero-calls-on-load behavior for either agent.
